finding.title: fetch_report lowers the OpenSSL security level to 0.
finding.description: fetch_report lowers the OpenSSL security level to 0, so a server could negotiate an export-grade or RC4 cipher suite with it. Analyze this component only.

source_files.content:
import ssl
import urllib.request


def fetch_report(url):
    context = ssl.create_default_context()
    context.set_ciphers("DEFAULT:@SECLEVEL=0")
    with urllib.request.urlopen(url, context=context, timeout=5) as response:
        return response.read()
